seriesId.description: The unique identity of the series.

accountId.description: The unique identity of the account.

type.description: Whether the transaction is income or payment

description.description: The full text description of the transactions - often as it is represented on the users bank statement

cleanedDescription.description: A cleaned up and shorter description of the transaction, this can be edited

counterpartyId.description: A matching id of the counterparty of the series

frequency.description: The time between payments in the series

numTxMatchedInSeries.description: The count of the transactions in the series

gapLengthInFreqUnits.description: The count of expected dates with no corresponding transactions

dateAnomaliesCount.description: The count of transactions which occurred outside the predicted date range

numReturnedTxs.description: The count of transactions we have detected were returned (reversed/declined)

lastDate.description: Date on which the most recent transaction in the series occured

predictedDate.description: Predicted date the next transactions is most likely to occur

predictedDateEarliest.description: Earliest predicted date of the next transaction in the series

predictedDateLatest.description: Lastest predicted date of the next transaction in the series

predictedTxLateOrNotDetected.description: Is the predicted payment late or not detected?

predictedAmount.description: Predicted amount of the next transaction

value.description: The amount of the transaction in minor units of the currency, eg. pennies for GBP, negative means money going out of an account, positive means money coming into an account.

majorUnits.description: The major units of the value, based on the values currency, eg. pounds for GBP.

minorUnits.description: The minor units of the value, based on the values currency, eg. pennies for GBP.

predictedAmountLower.description: The smallest amount predicted for the next transaction

minorUnits.description: The minor units of the value, based on the values currency, eg. pennies for GBP.
